product_metadata.title: Umbra 1008099-660 Wallflower Adhesive Wall Decor, Set of 10, White
features: ATTRACTIVE SIMPLE DESIGN: Crafted with molded polypropylene and a clean, matte white finish, Wallflower is a dynamic addition to any space
VARIETY OF SIZES: The flowers comes in five different sizes, ranging from 2.5 x 2.5 x 1 inches – 4.5 x 4.5 x 2.5 inches
EASY TO INSTALL: The flowers have snap fit connectors and are mounted using an easy tab adhesive, all you have to do is simply stick Wallflower to your wall or ceiling
VERSATILE WALL DÉCOR: Wallflower can be hung in any formation and has endless configuration options
DESIGNED BY MARION LANKTREE FOR UMBRA: Wallflower is simplistic in form and adds a modern decorative touch to your space
description: Looking to liven up your wall space with subtle, yet compelling wall decor?

Wallflower'sclean shape and geometric, yet curved white petals resemble an art-deco architectural style. Easily mounted using the product'ssticky backing, installation is quick and hassle-free; removal is equally as painless, simply peel the flowers off.

The beautiful floral display comes in a set of 10 molded flowers, with a choice of five different sizes, ranging from 2.5 x 2.5 x 1 inch (6.4 x 6.4 x 2.5 cm) to 4.5 x 4.5 x 2.5 inch (11.4 x 11.4 x 6 cm).
Designed by Marion Lanktree, Wallflower'ssimple and modern form allows it to be seamlessly added to any space as wall decor; arrange the molded flowers to best reflect your desired space.
Order Wallflower today to embellish your wall space!
